_about: Where jobs come from. Each section maps to an adapter in src/jobhunter/sources/. Any entry or section can take "enabled": false. Keys starting with _ are comments.
_greenhouse_boards: Removed 2026-09-27: these boards' remote roles were US/Canada or single-country only. The greenhouse adapter still exists; add a "greenhouse_boards" list back to use it for a company that hires internationally.

lever_boards._note: Lever returns 'Document not found' and no Greenhouse/Ashby board exists under this name (checked 2026-09-25). Find their current careers page to re-add.

ashby_boards._note: Moved from greenhouse 'circleso' (404). Verified: the Ashby 'circle' board is Circle.so.
Moved from lever 'kraken123' (empty board). Kraken's jobs are on Ashby now.

serpapi._note: Google Jobs (includes LinkedIn postings). Needs SERPAPI_API_KEY in .env; skipped without it. One credit per query page per run: 7 queries x 1 page = 7 credits/day.

remote_api._note: Remotive. Its API ignores search terms and returns its latest jobs; local filters decide.

himalayas._note: country=LB makes Himalayas return jobs that list Lebanon or list no countries. No countries is treated as unknown, not worldwide.

remoteok._note: The API returns its latest ~100 jobs only. 'queries' is a local filter on title + tags.

hackernews._note: Latest 'Ask HN: Who is hiring?' thread.

hiringcafe._note: Not implemented: hiring.cafe blocks automated requests (HTTP 403).

remote100k._note: Not implemented: HTML only, no feed. Categories are /remote-jobs/<slug> (engineering, software-engineer); 'python'/'fastapi' pages do not exist.
